```{r}



t_distrito <- s3read_using(
  FUN      = readxl::read_xlsx,
  sheet    = 2,
  object   = "turismo/exp_viv_turistica_tabla5_MAY2026.xlsx",
  bucket   = "mperier",
  opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
) %>% select(c("CUDIS", "Nivel", "vivienda turistica", "plazas", "plazas por vivienda turistica", "Porcentaje vivienda turistica", "PERIODO", "PROV", "PROV_LITERAL", "MUN", "MUN_LITERAL"))



```

Joining districts with their geographical borders. We know the polygone for each census tract so we reconstruct distritos geography from that.

```{r frontières géo}
base <- "turismo/secciones2026_geo/SECC_CE_20260101"   # sans extension
dir.create("shp_tmp", showWarnings = FALSE)


for (ext in c("shp", "dbf", "shx", "prj", "CPG")) {
  dest <- file.path("shp_tmp", paste0("SECC_CE_20260101.", ext))
  
  tryCatch(
    s3read_using(
      FUN    = function(f, dest) file.copy(f, dest, overwrite = TRUE),
      dest   = dest,
      object = paste0(base, ".", ext),
      bucket = "mperier",
      opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
    ),
    error = function(e) message("Échec pour .", ext, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}

list.files("shp_tmp")


secc <- st_read("shp_tmp/SECC_CE_20260101.shp")
names(secc)   

# 1. Réparer les géométries invalides avant toute fusion
secc <- st_make_valid(secc)

# 3. Dissoudre : regrouper par distrito
distritos <- secc |>
  group_by(CUDIS) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Vérifications 
nrow(distritos) # Il en manque 8 : "4316101" "3601302" "3602503" "3208902" "2523403" "2301803" "0814102" "0407002" 
# pour les voir anti_join(t_distrito, st_drop_geometry(distritos),by = c("CUDIS" = "CUDIS"))
plot(st_geometry(distritos))
all(st_is_valid(distritos))

sf_distritos <- t_distrito %>% left_join(distritos, by = "CUDIS")
rm(distritos)
```
